validation_harness.batch_source:
import json
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

records = []
cases = [("after_before_expiry", "2026-11-30T23:59:59Z", []),
         ("after_just_expired", "2026-12-01T00:00:01Z", []),
         ("after_future", "2027-06-01T00:00:00Z", []),
         ("after_real", "real", []),
         ("negative_control_no_pin", "2026-12-01T00:00:01Z",
          ["--disable-pin", "-k", "test_cli_paths_pin_probe_clock_after_approval_expiry"])]
cases += [(f"repeat_{i}", "real", []) for i in range(1, 6)]
for name, clock, extra in cases:
    argv = [".venv-pantheon/bin/python3", "/tmp/ci-risk-binding-clock-pytest.py", clock, *extra]
    start = time.monotonic()
    result = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
    record = dict(name=name, clock=clock, command=argv, exit_code=result.returncode,
                  elapsed_seconds=round(time.monotonic()-start, 3),
                  stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr)
    records.append(record)
    print(json.dumps(record), flush=True)
    Path('/tmp/ci-risk-binding-validation-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(records, indent=2)+'\n')
    expected_code = 1 if name == "negative_control_no_pin" else 0
    if result.returncode != expected_code:
        raise SystemExit(f"Unexpected exit for {name}: {result.returncode}")
